before.name: Glimmer of Hope
before.description: A talisman of hope in the darkest of times, its light pierces through despair and guides lost souls to safety. Wielded by healers and guardians of the light, it offers solace and protection to those in need.

set.description_de: Ein Zeichen der Hoffnung in den dunkelsten Zeiten. Sein Licht durchdringt die Verzweiflung und geleitet verlorene Seelen in Sicherheit. Von Heilern und Hütern des Lichts getragen, spendet er Bedürftigen Trost und Schutz.
set.description_eng: A symbol of hope in the darkest of times. Its light pierces through despair and guides lost souls to safety. Carried by healers and guardians of the light, it offers comfort and protection to those in need.
